legacy.text: Skip to main content CrowAgent Products Pricing Blog FAQ About ⌘K Sign in Request access COMPARE › CROWMARK VS MYTENDER.IO HONEST COMPARISON CrowMark vs mytender.io Two UK-built tools for public-sector bidding. One publishes its pricing and grounds every figure; the other is a private-cloud drafting platform. Every competitor fact is sourced. Updated 26 July 2026 CrowMark is a UK bid and tender management suite priced from £49 per month. mytender.io is a UK AI tender-writing platform, built at the University of Southampton, that does not publish a price. Both are aimed at bid data that cannot go through general public AI tools. This page compares them feature by feature, states CrowMark's prices, marks anything mytender.io does not publish as Not published, and dates every source. At a glance CrowMark compared with mytender.io across category, features and pricing FEATURE CROWMARK MYTENDER.IO Category UK bid and tender management suite UK AI tender-writing platform UK tender discovery (Contracts Finder + Find a Tender) Yes, refreshed daily at 06:00 No own feed stated; partnered with a UK tender portal Drafting grounded in your own answer library Yes Yes, retrieval over your content library Figure-grounding (AI blocked from inventing a number) Yes, deterministic gate Not stated publicly PPN 017 AI-use disclosure on every draft Yes Not stated publicly PPN 002 social value calculation (10% floor) Yes, deterministic Not a dedicated calculator Post-award delivery evidence (Procurement Act 2023 s.52 / s.71) Yes Not stated Private-cloud (VPC) deployment Standard cloud, UK and EU data residency Yes, Virtual Private Cloud Content-tool integrations (SharePoint, Salesforce, Google Drive) Focus is tender sources and exports Yes Published price Yes No Starting price £49/month Not published (on request) Best for UK SMEs and public-sector suppliers UK SMEs producing 10+ bids a year What is mytender.io? mytender.io is a UK AI tender-writing platform founded at the University of Southampton by Samuel Aaron, Jamie Horsnell and Nicolas Dickreuter, with pre-seed investment led by Fuel Ventures. It drafts proposal answers using retrieval over a content library the customer builds from past bids, and it runs inside a Virtual Private Cloud to address the confidentiality concerns that keep bid data out of general public AI tools. It lists integrations with SharePoint, Salesforce and Google Drive, and has stated a partnership with a large UK public-sector tender portal. Those are real strengths. The Virtual Private Cloud model and the SharePoint, Salesforce and Google Drive integrations matter to teams with a heavy internal document estate, and CrowMark does not lead on either of those today. If your priority is a private-cloud drafting workspace wired into your existing content tools, mytender.io is built around that. mytender.io does not publish a price. It points prospects to a demo or the in-app dashboard and offers a one-month refundable period after commencement. On this page we therefore mark its price as Not published. What is CrowMark? CrowMark is CrowAgent's UK bid and tender management suite. It tracks Contracts Finder and Find a Tender, drafts answers cited to the regulations, to the tender's own clauses and to the supplier's answer library, and calculates PPN 002 social value in code. Its defining rule is figure-grounding: before a draft is shown, every £ and % in the prose is checked against a set of allowed figures computed from your own data, and if a number is not in that set the draft is rejected. Every AI-assisted draft carries a PPN 017 AI-use disclosure and waits for a person to approve it. The PPN 002 mission mapping in CrowMark, shown with a sample account. The missions are the government’s own, mapped from the contract’s sector, and stay editable. After award, CrowMark keeps the commitment you bid attached to the contract: delivery percentages with a RAG status, evidence capture, monthly social-value reports, and checks against the Procurement Act 2023 KPI duties in sections 52 and 71. On security, it uses UK and EU data residency, AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. CrowMark publishes its pricing. Starter is £49 per month for 3 users, Pro is £149 per month for 10 users with post-award delivery tracking, and Portfolio is contact sales. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial. Pricing compared The pricing models are different in kind, not just in number. CrowMark states £49 and £149 per month in public, with a free trial and no demo required to see them. mytender.io keeps its tiers behind a demo or the dashboard. If knowing the cost up front is part of how you evaluate software, CrowMark gives you that immediately; if you prefer to see a tailored quote after a walkthrough, mytender.io's model fits that. Which should you choose? Choose mytender.io if A Virtual Private Cloud deployment is a hard requirement for your bid data. You want drafting wired into SharePoint, Salesforce or Google Drive. You produce ten or more bids a year and want a dedicated drafting workspace. You are comfortable getting pricing through a demo rather than up front. Choose CrowAgent (CrowMark) if You want published pricing from £49 per month with a free trial. You need Contracts Finder and Find a Tender discovery refreshed daily. You want the AI blocked from inventing a figure, with a PPN 017 disclosure on every draft. You need deterministic PPN 002 social value maths and post-award delivery evidence. Where CrowMark loses honestly mytender.io leads on two things CrowMark does not push today: a Virtual Private Cloud deployment model, which some security teams insist on, and native integrations with SharePoint, Salesforce and Google Drive for teams that manage their proposal content there. It is also further along on general drafting-workspace collaboration. CrowMark's focus is narrower and different: UK public-sector tender discovery, grounded answers with a hard figure-grounding gate, deterministic PPN 002 maths, and post-award delivery evidence under the Procurement Act 2023. The honest read is that they overlap on drafting but diverge on everything either side of it, and a team could reasonably run both. Frequently asked questions Is CrowMark or mytender.io cheaper? Does mytender.io publish its pricing? Is mytender.io a UK company? Does mytender.io find tenders for me? Which is more private or secure? Can either tool stop the AI inventing figures? Which suits an SME doing a few public-sector bids? Can I use both CrowMark and mytender.io?
